{{Quote|Former Supreme Chancellor Finis Valorum rolled up his shirt sleeves and grabbed a power-shovel, breaking soil and chipping in as the Refugee Relief Movement began transforming 100 hectares of donated Alderaanian plains into new homes.|HoloNet News report|<ref name="HNN49">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|49|news/13328_2.html|Alderaan Opens to Refugee Relief Movement}}</ref>}}
The '''hectare''' was a unit of area. On the planet [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], the site of [[Chianar]] was a [[Grass/Legends|grassy]] 100-hectare plot.<ref name="HNN49" /> On [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]], the [[Bakur Memorial Building]] filled several hectares between two radial highways.<ref name="TaB">''[[The Truce at Bakura]]''</ref>
